name: AgroGround
description: Data release of "AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture" (under review). Code: https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround. Contents: the 794,850 training examples (boxes, labels, crop-aware prompts, granularity, split) in eight per-source shards keyed by the sources' own identifiers, the 43,000 healthy images used as negatives, the human-verified benchmark in two versions (v4, 1,480 images, the version the submitted tables were computed on, v4.1, 1,478 images, which withdraws two images found to duplicate training negatives) with candidate lists, the prediction files of every model and protocol in the paper, per-image contamination flags, the perceptual-hash index. No source images and no question-answer text are included, users obtain the images from the original datasets. Licenses are per source: CC BY-SA 4.0 (MIRAGE, AgroCoT, AgMMU shards), CC BY-NC 4.0 (LeafNet, LeafBench shards), CC BY 4.0 (CDDM, AgroMind, AgroBench shards, and the prediction files, flags and index), the evaluation set is partitioned by source under the same terms. See README_DATA.md and LICENSES.md.
